subject: Request to substitute a tankless alternate in lieu of the storage-type water heater

messages.text: We're proposing a tankless alternate in lieu of the storage-type water heater specified in Section 22 34 00 and want sign-off before we order material. No rush -- please take a look whenever it's convenient. The substitution may affect the plumbing fixture budget depending on the manufacturer. No schedule impact is anticipated from this substitution. A response by the end of the day would let us keep the order on track.

The submittal for a tankless alternate in lieu of the storage-type water heater specified in Section 22 34 00 is acceptable provided it shows equivalent performance data and code-compliance listings for the assembly it replaces. The substitution may affect the plumbing fixture budget depending on the manufacturer.
